messages:
maria: Packaging complete for private/vpc installer v1.11.0-delta. Uploaded artifacts to gs://redwood-offline/1.11.0/installer.tar.gz and gs://redwood-offline/1.11.0/shrinkwrap.yaml. Requesting canary signoff + final release-note blurb.

release-bot: artifact uploaded: installer.tar.gz (size: 243MB)
release-bot: shrinkwrap.yaml attached

sam: quick q — did we rotate the cosign key for this bundle? last rotation was 2026-01-28.

maria: yes, cosign key rotated to vault:key/cosign-rot-2026-03. Signatures attached. Key TTL set to 90d per compliance.

jamal: ran local validation, one oddity: ubuntu-2204 image digest in shrinkwrap doesn't match the image mirror. Getting: expected sha256:6f7a... got sha256:6f7b...

packaging: confirming — mirror snapshot had a small patch rebuild. We need to pin the mirror digest or republish. Recommendation: republish signed submanifest with pinned digest and keep installer tar same. If republish, we must bump manifest epoch.

maria: republish path ok, but that's a cut. Can we avoid republish by changing shrinkwrap to the mirror digest and cosign again? Ops prefers pinned digest that matches what customers will pull.

olivia: for release notes, we should call out: 1) cosign key rotation, 2) pinned ubuntu-2204 digest fix, 3) installer performance tweaks. Short user-facing blurb ready, will paste once we settle dgest.

sam: rollback criteria proposal: abort rollout and revert to v1.10.x manifest if any of the following during canary (first 100 hosts): 1) packaging checksum mismatch reported by deploy agent, 2) canary p50 request latency >200ms or p95>500ms, 3) >=3 crashloop reports in 30m. Agree?

maria: +1. Also add automatic fallback to hosted model variant on capacity if installer images fail to pull.

packaging: I pushed a patched shrinkwrap.yaml that pins to mirror digest and re-cosigned. New shrinkwrap sha256: a12b3c4d. Installer tar unchanged.

release-bot: canary scheduled by deploy-bot for 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z (window 60m). Rollback automated hook enabled.

jamal: running final sha check locally:
```
sha256sum installer.tar.gz
a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1  installer.tar.gz
```

maria: thanks. Olivia, paste the release note here and I'll add the changelog and ship.

olivia: Release notes draft:
- Private/VPC installer v1.11.0-delta: packaging fixes and performance improvements.
- Security: rotated signing key and refreshed cosign signatures.
- Reliability: pinned ubuntu-2204 image digest to mirror snapshot to avoid mismatch during airgap installs.
- Ops: 60m canary window starting 23:00 UTC; automated rollback if checks fail.

maria: perfect. I'll update the release metadata, set epoch to 2026-03-20T23:00Z, and monitor the canary. If anyone sees an unexpected deploy-bot alert ping me. :eyes:

release-bot: note: changelog entry created at gs://redwood-offline/1.11.0/CHANGELOG.md

sam: thumbs up from infra. Good luck. :rocket:
